mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.0% consistently compresses equity discount rates during monetary easing cycles, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors price in sustained accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 1.0% (95% confidence interval), or Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.0% signals severe economic distress and reduced corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate further economic deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 500 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) below 340 billion dollars signal a broad-based demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a deepening economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances when both HOUST < 500 and RSAFS < 340000, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 in any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary easing cycles, a CPIAUCSL index below 215 (indicating low inflation) signals effective policy transmission, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in sustained accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 215 during monetary easing cycles, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when PAYEMS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 85 (index 2017=100) indicates contraction in manufacturing and supply chain activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a deepening economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when INDPRO < 85, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) below 11000 billion dollars and housing starts (HOUST) below 550 thousand units signal a severe economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates prolonged recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when both GDPC1 < 11000 and HOUST < 550, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery phases, rising retail sales (RSAFS) above 340 billion dollars signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in economic expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when RSAFS > 340000 during post-recession recovery, or Rank IC falls below 0.04 over 3-year rolling windows.
